POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.

2. When learning General workshop rules and regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after General workshop rules and regulations.
   B. Skip safety briefings for General workshop rules and regulations.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for General workshop rules and regulations.

3. When learning Evolution of motor vehicles, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Skip safety briefings for Evolution of motor vehicles.

4. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket

   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

5. When learning Vehicle body joining processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

6. When learning Blending of lines and curves, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Blending of lines and curves.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

8. When learning Road wheels, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Road wheels.

----
